checkpoint_selection: Final@10; no early stopping or epoch selection
negative_sampler: unchanged v1 uniform_negatives; identical exclusions/order/RNG and negative exposure between conditions
changed_factor: image-to-text positive aggregation only: uniform mean CE versus negative log probability of positive set; text-to-image mean CE unchanged
test_rule: Only if complete three-seed dev gate passes: evaluate all 6 fixed checkpoints and frozen CLIP on full test once. Otherwise no new test scores. Historical test exposure known; never call blind test or use test to tune.
limits: Complete same 28000 train/1000 dev/1000 test source images; frozen FP32 CLIP-B/32 cached features,not encoder fine tuning
Adaptive follow-up hypothesis informed by previous dev/test observations; pretraining overlap unknown; new gate does not erase historical exposure
Positive-set objective may neglect less easy positive captions; report nDCG and both retrieval directions
Only loss aggregation changes; not a reproduction of BLIP matching head,soft sampling,momentum distillation or SigLIP
Three training-seed sample SD separate from paired-image conditional intervals; no seed-image pseudo independence
